title: Examples for How to Configure Views
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM
The details view of individual payment lots shows various statistics, such as the following:

e Payment usage within a payment lot

e Duration of clarification activities

e Level of automation within one payment lot

1 Note

If you are using SAP Cash Application, add-on for contract accounting, the details view of individual payment lots shows the
proposal rate.

Examples for How to Configure Views

To display the total payment amount in relation to the open payment amount in a lot, select the following:

e Chart: Combined Stacked Line Chart
e Dimension: Lot
e Measure: Amount of Open Items

e Measure: Total Payment Amount
To display the total amount in relation to the number of items in a lot, select the following:

e Chart: Combined Column Line Chart with 2 Y-Axes
e Dimension: Lot
e Measure: Number of Items in Lot / Axis 1

e Measure: Total Payment Amount / Axis 2
To display percentages, select the following:

e Chart: 100% Stacked Column Chart
e Dimension: House Bank

e Measure: Payments in Clarification

e Measure: Payments Posted Manually

e Measure: Payments Posted Automatically

SAP Fiori Implementation Information

In the SAP Fiori Apps Reference Library, see the details for the Analyze Incoming Payments app.
